slice: AVI-MOVI-003 movi entry composition exact proof slice (not the whole Issue and not all of AVI-MOVI-003)

environment.memory_measurement: /usr/bin/time -v wrapping each cargo kani invocation; not per-solver cgroup isolation

input_domain.chunk_id: full [u8;4] chunk id; all 2^32 bit patterns. LIST/non-LIST, digit/non-digit prefixes, known/unknown/opaque kind suffixes, and non-ASCII bytes are not sampled or narrowed
input_domain.list_type_view: full Option<[u8;4]>; None means fewer than 4 body bytes are available for a direct child LIST, and Some(bytes) exactly represents the first 4 body bytes when the body length is at least 4. All 2^32 byte patterns are symbolic
input_domain.production_reparameterization: production observes only the presence/absence of the first four bytes of a LIST body for this decision; body tail bytes, padding, chunk size, and offsets are outside the decision-core input rather than narrowed symbolic inputs
input_domain.non_list_total_extension: for non-LIST ids the production loop passes None or the input is unobserved; the proof keeps the symbolic Option domain and verifies that the decision does not depend on it
input_domain.excluded_inputs: none within the entry decision input domain. Outer RIFF/LIST structure, multiple entries, body slices, stream declarations, packet payload interpretation, and timing inputs are outside this sub-boundary

assume_classification: No kani::assume and no input narrowing. Constructing Option<[u8;4]> symbolically is exact reparameterization of the observed body-prefix interface. Equality/inequality branches in assertions are exact complement checks, not assumptions.

coverage.rec_list: id==LIST and list_type_view==Some exact bytes rec plus trailing space iff RejectRecList; byte order, case, and trailing space are exact
coverage.non_rec_list_ignore: id==LIST and any Some byte complement of exact rec plus trailing space iff Ignore
coverage.packet: id!=LIST and avi_movi_packet_tag(id) is Some iff Packet(tag)
coverage.non_list_ignore: id!=LIST and avi_movi_packet_tag(id) is None iff Ignore
coverage.exact_complement: exactly one of Packet/Ignore/RejectShortListType/RejectRecList holds for every input
coverage.tag_preservation: packet tags preserve stream_no=(id[0]-b'0')*10+(id[1]-b'0'), 0<=stream_no<=99, and kind byte order
coverage.arithmetic_safety: the helper is checked for overflow/underflow/panic freedom over the full symbolic input domain
coverage.production_connection: the production movi loop calls avi_movi_entry_decision with the same inner chunk id returned by Chunks::next and a LIST-only body-prefix view; shell error mapping, boundary walking, body slices, and Vec collection remain outside the helper
coverage.boundary_connection: packet body boundary/padding remains the separate AVI-CHUNK-001 layer proved by avi_chunk_step_exact in PR #284; digit/kind arithmetic remains the AVI-MOVI-003 tag layer proved in PR #286

initial_lane_before_mutation.note: initial cold-cache pass retained as auxiliary evidence; final canonical lane is kani/ after mutation revert

mutation.description: temporary production mutation changed the LIST short-type arm in avi_movi_entry_decision from RejectShortListType to Ignore
mutation.expected_detection: avi-movi-composition proof must fail; generic boundary-only/tag-only failures or diagnostic-payload-only mutations are not accepted as composition oracle evidence
mutation.revert: mutation reverted exactly; final avi-movi-composition lane, mise run test al-media, and mise run test-formal passed after revert
